sanskrit: kiṃdravyās tāḥ sabhā brahman kiṃvistārāḥ kimāyatāḥ pitāmahaṃ ca ke tasyāṃ sabhāyāṃ paryupāsate
english: Of what materials are those assembly halls, O brahmin? What is their extent and length? And who attends upon the Grandfather in that assembly?

sanskrit: vāsavaṃ devarājaṃ ca yamaṃ vaivasvataṃ ca ke varuṇaṃ ca kuberaṃ ca sabhāyāṃ paryupāsate
english: Who attends upon Vāsava the king of gods, upon Yama the son of Vivasvat, upon Varuṇa, and upon Kubera in their assemblies?

sanskrit: etat sarvaṃ yathātattvaṃ devarṣe vadatas tava śrotum icchāma sahitāḥ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ
english: All of this in its true detail, O divine seer — we wish to hear it from you as you speak; our curiosity is very great.

sanskrit: evam uktaḥ pāṇḍavena nāradaḥ pratyuvāca tam krameṇa rājan divyās tāḥ śrūyantām iha naḥ sabhāḥ
english: Thus addressed by the Pāṇḍava, Nārada replied to him: "In order, O king, let those divine halls be heard by us now."

sanskrit: nārada uvāca śakrasya tu sabhā divyā bhāsvarā karmabhir jitā svayaṃ śakreṇa kauravya nirmitārkasamaprabhā
english: Nārada said: The divine assembly of Śakra is radiant, won by his deeds; built by Śakra himself, O Kauravya, it blazes like the sun.

sanskrit: vistīrṇā yojanaśataṃ śatam adhyardham āyatā vaihāyasī kāmagamā pañcayojanam ucchritā
english: It is a hundred yojanas wide and one hundred and fifty yojanas long; it moves through the sky at will and rises five yojanas high.

sanskrit: jarāśokaklamāpetā nirātaṅkā śivā śubhā veśmāsanavatī ramyā divyapādapaśobhitā
english: Free from old age, sorrow, and fatigue, without fear, auspicious and fair, furnished with rooms and seats, delightful, adorned with divine trees.

sanskrit: tasyāṃ deveśvaraḥ pārtha sabhāyāṃ paramāsane āste śacyā mahendrāṇyā śriyā lakṣmyā ca bhārata
english: In that assembly, O Pārtha, the lord of gods sits on the highest throne, together with Śacī the wife of Mahendra, with Śrī and Lakṣmī, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: bibhrad vapur anirdeśyaṃ kirīṭī lohitāṅgadaḥ virajombaraś citramālyo hrīkīrtidyutibhiḥ saha
english: Wearing a form beyond description, crowned, with red armlets, clad in spotless garments, adorned with varied garlands, accompanied by Modesty, Fame, and Splendour.

sanskrit: tasyām upāsate nityaṃ mahātmānaṃ śatakratum marutaḥ sarvato rājan sarve ca gṛhamedhinaḥ siddhā devarṣayaś caiva sādhyā devagaṇās tathā
english: In that assembly, O king, the Maruts always attend the great-souled Śatakratu from all sides — all the householder-gods, the Siddhas, the divine seers, the Sādhyas, and the hosts of gods as well.

sanskrit: ete sānucarāḥ sarve divyarūpāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ upāsate mahātmānaṃ devarājam ariṃdamam
english: All of these, with their attendants, bearing divine forms and well-adorned, attend upon the great-souled king of gods, the subduer of enemies.

sanskrit: tathā devarṣayaḥ sarve pārtha śakram upāsate amalā dhūtapāpmāno dīpyamānā ivāgnayaḥ tejasvinaḥ somayujo vipāpā vigataklamāḥ
english: Likewise all the divine seers, O Pārtha, attend upon Śakra — spotless, their sins shaken off, blazing like fires, radiant, united with Soma, free from evil, weariness gone.

sanskrit: parāśaraḥ parvataś ca tathā sāvarṇigālavau śaṅkhaś ca likhitaś caiva tathā gauraśirā muniḥ
english: Parāśara and Parvata, and likewise Sāvarṇi and Gālava, Śaṅkha and Likhita, and the sage Gauraśiras as well.

sanskrit: durvāsāś ca dīrghatapā yājñavalkyo 'tha bhālukiḥ uddālakaḥ śvetaketus tathā śāṭyāyanaḥ prabhuḥ
english: Durvāsas the long-ascetic, and Yājñavalkya, Bhāluki, Uddālaka, Śvetaketu, and the mighty Śāṭyāyana.

sanskrit: haviṣmāṃś ca gaviṣṭhaś ca hariścandraś ca pārthivaḥ hṛdyaś codaraśāṇḍilyaḥ pārāśaryaḥ kṛṣīvalaḥ
english: Haviṣmān and Gaviṣṭha, and king Hariścandra, Hṛdya and Udaraśāṇḍilya, Pārāśarya and Kṛṣīvala.

sanskrit: vātaskandho viśākhaś ca vidhātā kāla eva ca anantadantas tvaṣṭā ca viśvakarmā ca tumburuḥ
english: Vātaskandha and Viśākha, Vidhātā and Kāla himself, Anantadanta and Tvaṣṭā, Viśvakarmā and Tumburu.

sanskrit: ayonijā yonijāś ca vāyubhakṣā hutāśinaḥ īśānaṃ sarvalokasya vajriṇaṃ samupāsate
english: Those born not of the womb and those born of the womb, those who live on wind and those who feed on oblations — they all attend upon Īśāna, the lord of all worlds, the bearer of the thunderbolt.

sanskrit: sahadevaḥ sunīthaś ca vālmīkiś ca mahātapāḥ samīkaḥ satyavāṃś caiva pracetāḥ satyasaṃgaraḥ
english: Sahadeva and Sunītha, and Vālmīki of great austerity, Śamīka and Satyavān, Pracetas and Satyasaṃgara.

sanskrit: medhātithir vāmadevaḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ maruttaś ca marīciś ca sthāṇuś cātrir mahātapāḥ
english: Medhātithi and Vāmadeva, Pulastya and Pulaha, Kratu, Marutta and Marīci, Sthāṇu and Atri of great austerity.

sanskrit: kakṣīvān gautamas tārkṣyas tathā vaiśvānaro muniḥ muniḥ kālakavṛkṣīya āśrāvyo 'tha hiraṇyadaḥ saṃvarto devahavyaś ca viṣvaksenaś ca vīryavān
english: Kakṣīvān and Gautama, Tārkṣya and the sage Vaiśvānara, the sage Kālakavṛkṣīya, Āśrāvya and Hiraṇyada, Saṃvarta and Devahavya, and the mighty Viṣvaksena.

sanskrit: divyā āpas tathauṣadhyaḥ śraddhā medhā sarasvatī artho dharmaś ca kāmaś ca vidyutaś cāpi pāṇḍava
english: The divine waters and the herbs, Faith and Intellect, Sarasvatī, Wealth and Dharma and Desire, and Lightning too, O Pāṇḍava.

sanskrit: jalavāhās tathā meghā vāyavaḥ stanayitnavaḥ prācī dig yajñavāhāś ca pāvakāḥ saptaviṃśatiḥ
english: The rain-bearing clouds, the winds, the thunders, the Eastern Direction, the sacrifice-bearers, and the twenty-seven sacred fires.

sanskrit: agnīṣomau tathendrāgnī mitro 'tha savitāryamā bhago viśve ca sādhyāś ca śukro manthī ca bhārata
english: Agni and Soma, Indra and Agni together, Mitra and Savitṛ, Aryaman, Bhaga, the Viśve-devās, the Sādhyas, Śukra and Manthī, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: yajñāś ca dakṣiṇāś caiva grahāḥ stobhāś ca sarvaśaḥ yajñavāhāś ca ye mantrāḥ sarve tatra samāsate
english: The sacrifices and the sacrificial fees, the planets, all the Stobha chants, and whatever mantras carry the sacrifice — all of them are assembled there.

sanskrit: tathaivāpsaraso rājan gandharvāś ca manoramāḥ nṛtyavāditragītaiś ca hāsyaiś ca vividhair api ramayanti sma nṛpate devarājaṃ śatakratum
english: So too the Apsarases, O king, and the charming Gandharvas, with dance and instrumental music and song, and with varied forms of laughter, they delight the king of gods, the Śatakratu.

sanskrit: stutibhir maṅgalaiś caiva stuvantaḥ karmabhis tathā vikramaiś ca mahātmānaṃ balavṛtraniṣūdanam
english: Praising him with hymns and auspicious words, extolling him for his deeds and his exploits — the great-souled slayer of Bala and Vṛtra.

sanskrit: brahmarājarṣayaḥ sarve sarve devarṣayas tathā vimānair vividhair divyair bhrājamānair ivāgnibhiḥ
english: All the brahmin royal sages, and all the divine seers as well, in varied celestial aerial cars blazing like fires.

sanskrit: sragviṇo bhūṣitāś cānye yānti cāyānti cāpare bṛhaspatiś ca śukraś ca tasyām āyayatuḥ saha
english: Garlanded and adorned, some go and others come; Bṛhaspati and Śukra both come to that assembly together.

sanskrit: ete cānye ca bahavo yatātmāno yatavratāḥ vimānaiś candrasaṃkāśaiḥ somavat priyadarśanāḥ brahmaṇo vacanād rājan bhṛguḥ saptarṣayas tathā
english: These and many others, of controlled minds and disciplined vows, in aerial cars bright as the moon, lovely to behold as Soma — by Brahmā's word, O king, Bhṛgu and the Seven Sages as well.

sanskrit: eṣā sabhā mayā rājan dṛṣṭā puṣkaramālinī śatakrator mahārāja yāmyāṃ śṛṇu mamānagha
english: This is the assembly, O king, crowned with lotus garlands, that I have seen — the assembly of Śatakratu, O great king. Now hear of the assembly of Yama, O sinless one.

sanskrit: nārada uvāca kathayiṣye sabhāṃ divyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira nibodha tām vaivasvatasya yām arthe viśvakarmā cakāra ha
english: Nārada said: I will describe the divine assembly hall, O Yudhiṣṭhira — understand it — the one that Viśvakarmā made for Vaivasvata's purpose.

sanskrit: taijasī sā sabhā rājan babhūva śatayojanā vistārāyāmasaṃpannā bhūyasī cāpi pāṇḍava
english: That assembly of fire-like brilliance, O king, was a hundred yojanas in extent of breadth and length, and was very vast indeed, O Pāṇḍava.

sanskrit: arkaprakāśā bhrājiṣṇuḥ sarvataḥ kāmacāriṇī naivātiśītā nātyuṣṇā manasaś ca praharṣiṇī
english: Radiant as the sun, blazing with light, moving in all directions at will, neither too cold nor too hot, and filling the mind with delight.

sanskrit: na śoko na jarā tasyāṃ kṣutpipāse na cāpriyam na ca dainyaṃ klamo vāpi pratikūlaṃ na cāpy uta
english: In that hall there is no grief, no old age, no hunger or thirst, nothing unpleasant, no misery or fatigue, nor anything adverse whatsoever.

sanskrit: sarve kāmāḥ sthitās tasyāṃ ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ rasavac ca prabhūtaṃ ca bhakṣyabhojyam ariṃdama
english: All desires, both divine and human, are present there, and food to eat and drink in abundance and full of flavor, O subduer of enemies.

sanskrit: puṇyagandhāḥ srajas tatra nityapuṣpaphaladrumāḥ rasavanti ca toyāni śītāny uṣṇāni caiva ha
english: There are garlands of sacred fragrance, trees bearing flowers and fruits perpetually, and waters full of taste, both cold and warm.

sanskrit: tasyāṃ rājarṣayaḥ puṇyās tathā brahmarṣayo 'malāḥ yamaṃ vaivasvataṃ tāta prahṛṣṭāḥ paryupāsate
english: In that assembly, holy royal sages and pure brahmin sages attend with joy upon Yama the son of Vivasvat, O dear one.

sanskrit: yayātir nahuṣaḥ pūrur māndhātā somako nṛgaḥ trasadasyuś ca turayaḥ kṛtavīryaḥ śrutaśravāḥ
english: Yayāti and Nahuṣa, Pūru, Māndhātā, Somaka, and Nṛga, Trasadasyu and Turaya, Kṛtavīrya and Śrutaśravas.

sanskrit: aripraṇut susiṃhaś ca kṛtavegaḥ kṛtir nimiḥ pratardanaḥ śibir matsyaḥ pṛthvakṣo 'tha bṛhadrathaḥ
english: Aripraṇut and Susiṃha, Kṛtavega and Kṛti, Nimi, Pratardana, Śibi, Matsya, Pṛthvakṣa, and Bṛhadratha.

sanskrit: aiḍo maruttaḥ kuśikaḥ sāṃkāśyaḥ sāṃkṛtir bhavaḥ caturaśvaḥ sadaśvormiḥ kārtavīryaś ca pārthivaḥ
english: Aiḍa, Marutta, Kuśika, Sāṃkāśya, Sāṃkṛti, Bhava, Caturaśva, Sadaśvormi, and the king Kārtavīrya.

sanskrit: bharatas tathā surathaḥ sunītho naiṣadho nalaḥ divodāso 'tha sumanā ambarīṣo bhagīrathaḥ
english: Bharata and Suratha, Sunītha, Naiṣadha Nala, Divodāsa and Sumanā, Ambarīṣa and Bhagīratha.

sanskrit: vyaśvaḥ sadaśvo vadhryaśvaḥ pañcahastaḥ pṛthuśravāḥ ruṣadgur vṛṣasenaś ca kṣupaś ca sumahābalaḥ
english: Vyaśva, Sadaśva, Vadhryaśva, Pañcahasta, Pṛthuśravas, Ruṣadgu, Vṛṣasena, and the very mighty Kṣupa.

sanskrit: ruṣadaśvo vasumanāḥ purukutso dhvajī rathī ārṣṭiṣeṇo dilīpaś ca mahātmā cāpy uśīnaraḥ
english: Ruṣadaśva, Vasumanās, Purukutsa, the banner-bearer and chariot-warrior, Ārṣṭiṣeṇa, Dilīpa, and the great-souled Uśīnara.

sanskrit: auśīnaraḥ puṇḍarīkaḥ śaryātiḥ śarabhaḥ śuciḥ aṅgo 'riṣṭaś ca venaś ca duḥṣantaḥ saṃjayo jayaḥ
english: Auśīnara, Puṇḍarīka, Śaryāti, Śarabha, Śuci, Aṅga, Ariṣṭa, Vena, Duḥṣanta, Saṃjaya, and Jaya.

sanskrit: bhāṅgāsvariḥ sunīthaś ca niṣadho 'tha tviṣīrathaḥ karaṃdhamo bāhlikaś ca sudyumno balavān madhuḥ
english: Bhāṅgāsvari and Sunītha, Niṣadha and Tviṣīratha, Karaṃdhama and Bāhlika, Sudyumna, the mighty Madhu.

sanskrit: kapotaromā tṛṇakaḥ sahadevārjunau tathā rāmo dāśarathiś caiva lakṣmaṇo 'tha pratardanaḥ
english: Kapotaromā, Tṛṇaka, Sahadeva and Arjuna as well, Rāma the son of Daśaratha, and Lakṣmaṇa, and Pratardana.

sanskrit: alarkaḥ kakṣasenaś ca gayo gaurāśva eva ca jāmadagnyo 'tha rāmo 'tra nābhāgasagarau tathā
english: Alarka and Kakṣasena, Gaya and Gaurāśva, Rāma the son of Jamadagni as well, Nābhāga and Sagara.

sanskrit: bhūridyumno mahāśvaś ca pṛthvaśvo janakas tathā vainyo rājā vāriṣeṇaḥ purujo janamejayaḥ
english: Bhūridyumna and Mahāśva, Pṛtvaśva and Janaka, king Vainya, Vāriṣeṇa, Puruja, and Janamejaya.

sanskrit: brahmadattas trigartaś ca rājoparicaras tathā indradyumno bhīmajānur gayaḥ pṛṣṭho nayo 'naghaḥ
english: Brahmadatta and Trigarta, the sky-roaming king Uparicara, Indradyumna, Bhīmajānu, Gaya, Pṛṣṭha, the sinless Naya.

sanskrit: padmo 'tha mucukundaś ca bhūridyumnaḥ prasenajit ariṣṭanemiḥ pradyumnaḥ pṛthagaśvo 'jakas tathā
english: Padma and Mucukunda, Bhūridyumna, Prasenajit, Ariṣṭanemi, Pradyumna, Pṛthagaśva, and Aja.

sanskrit: śataṃ matsyā nṛpatayaḥ śataṃ nīpāḥ śataṃ hayāḥ dhṛtarāṣṭrāś caikaśatam aśītir janamejayāḥ
english: A hundred Matsya kings, a hundred Nīpas, a hundred Hayas, one hundred and one Dhṛtarāṣṭras, eighty Janamejayās.

sanskrit: śataṃ ca brahmadattānām īriṇāṃ vairiṇāṃ śatam śaṃtanuś caiva rājarṣiḥ pāṇḍuś caiva pitā tava
english: A hundred Brahmadattas, a hundred of the Īriṇas and Vairiṇas, and the royal sage Śaṃtanu, and Pāṇḍu your own father.

sanskrit: uśadgavaḥ śataratho devarājo jayadrathaḥ vṛṣādarbhiś ca rājarṣir dhāmnā saha samantriṇā
english: Uśadgava, Śataratha, the king of gods Jayadratha, and the royal sage Vṛṣādarbhi together with his minister Dhāman.

sanskrit: athāpare sahasrāṇi ye gatāḥ śaśabindavaḥ iṣṭvāśvamedhair bahubhir mahadbhir bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ
english: And others in thousands — those Śaśabindus who have gone there, having performed many great horse-sacrifices with abundant fees.

sanskrit: ete rājarṣayaḥ puṇyāḥ kīrtimanto bahuśrutāḥ tasyāṃ sabhāyāṃ rājarṣe vaivasvatam upāsate
english: These holy royal sages, famous and widely learned, attend upon Vaivasvata in that assembly, O royal sage.

sanskrit: agastyo 'tha mataṅgaś ca kālo mṛtyus tathaiva ca yajvānaś caiva siddhāś ca ye ca yogaśarīriṇaḥ
english: Agastya and Mataṅga, and likewise Kāla and Mṛtyu, the sacrificers and the Siddhas, and those whose bodies are made of yoga.

sanskrit: agniṣvāttāś ca pitaraḥ phenapāś coṣmapāś ca ye svadhāvanto barhiṣado mūrtimantas tathāpare
english: The Agniṣvātta ancestors and those who drink foam and those who drink steam, those who partake of the ritual offering, those who sit on the sacred grass, and others who have taken bodily form.

sanskrit: kālacakraṃ ca sākṣāc ca bhagavān havyavāhanaḥ narā duṣkṛtakarmāṇo dakṣiṇāyanamṛtyavaḥ
english: The wheel of Time itself in visible form, and the blessed fire the carrier of oblations, and men of evil deeds who die during the southern course of the sun.

sanskrit: kālasya nayane yuktā yamasya puruṣāś ca ye tasyāṃ śiṃśapapālāśās tathā kāśakuśādayaḥ upāsate dharmarājaṃ mūrtimanto nirāmayāḥ
english: Those who are yoked to Kāla's leading, and the attendants of Yama — in that assembly the Śiṃśapa and Pālāśa trees, as well as Kāśa and Kuśa grasses and others, attend in embodied form upon the king of dharma, free from affliction.

sanskrit: ete cānye ca bahavaḥ pitṛrājasabhāsadaḥ aśakyāḥ parisaṃkhyātuṃ nāmabhiḥ karmabhis tathā
english: These and many others are the members of the assembly of the king of ancestors — it is impossible to enumerate them all by name and deeds.

sanskrit: asaṃbādhā hi sā pārtha ramyā kāmagamā sabhā dīrghakālaṃ tapas taptvā nirmitā viśvakarmaṇā
english: That hall is unobstructed, O Pārtha, delightful, moving at will — built by Viśvakarmā after performing austerities for a long time.

sanskrit: prabhāsantī jvalantīva tejasā svena bhārata tām ugratapaso yānti suvratāḥ satyavādinaḥ
english: Blazing with its own splendour as if on fire, O Bhārata — to that hall go those of fierce austerity, of excellent vows, speakers of truth.

sanskrit: śāntāḥ saṃnyāsinaḥ siddhāḥ pūtāḥ puṇyena karmaṇā sarve bhāsvaradehāś ca sarve ca virajombarāḥ
english: Peaceful, renunciant, accomplished, purified by holy deeds — all of them with radiant bodies and all clad in spotless garments.

sanskrit: citrāṅgadāś citramālyāḥ sarve jvalitakuṇḍalāḥ sukṛtaiḥ karmabhiḥ puṇyaiḥ paribarhair vibhūṣitāḥ
english: With varied armlets and varied garlands, all with blazing earrings, adorned with the trappings of holy and meritorious deeds.

sanskrit: gandharvāś ca mahātmānaḥ śataśaś cāpsarogaṇāḥ vāditraṃ nṛttagītaṃ ca hāsyaṃ lāsyaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
english: Great-souled Gandharvas in their hundreds and hosts of Apsarases — with instruments, dance and song, laughter and graceful movement in full measure.

sanskrit: puṇyāś ca gandhāḥ śabdāś ca tasyāṃ pārtha samantataḥ divyāni mālyāni ca tām upatiṣṭhanti sarvaśaḥ
english: Sacred fragrances and sounds pervade that hall on all sides, O Pārtha, and divine garlands serve it from every quarter.

sanskrit: śataṃ śatasahasrāṇi dharmiṇāṃ taṃ prajeśvaram upāsate mahātmānaṃ rūpayuktā manasvinaḥ
english: A hundred times a hundred thousand righteous beings, endowed with beauty and intelligence, attend upon that great-souled lord of creatures.

sanskrit: īdṛśī sā sabhā rājan pitṛrājño mahātmanaḥ varuṇasyāpi vakṣyāmi sabhāṃ puṣkaramālinīm
english: Such is that assembly hall, O king, of the great-souled king of the ancestors. I will also describe the lotus-garlanded assembly of Varuṇa.

sanskrit: nārada uvāca yudhiṣṭhira sabhā divyā varuṇasya sitaprabhā pramāṇena yathā yāmyā śubhaprākāratoraṇā
english: Nārada said: O Yudhiṣṭhira, the divine assembly of Varuṇa is white-gleaming; in size it matches the hall of Yama, with auspicious walls and gateways.

sanskrit: antaḥsalilam āsthāya vihitā viśvakarmaṇā divyaratnamayair vṛkṣaiḥ phalapuṣpapradair yutā
english: Built within the waters by Viśvakarmā, it is adorned with divine jewel-made trees that bestow fruits and flowers.

sanskrit: nīlapītāsitaśyāmaiḥ sitair lohitakair api avatānais tathā gulmaiḥ puṣpamañjaridhāribhiḥ
english: With trees of blue, yellow, white, dark, and red hues as well, with drooping boughs and with shrubs bearing clusters of blossoms.

sanskrit: tathā śakunayas tasyāṃ nānārūpā mṛdusvarāḥ anirdeśyā vapuṣmantaḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ
english: And in that hall are birds of many forms with sweet voices, of indescribable beauty, by the hundreds and by the thousands.

sanskrit: sā sabhā sukhasaṃsparśā na śītā na ca gharmadā veśmāsanavatī ramyā sitā varuṇapālitā
english: That assembly hall has a pleasant touch, neither cold nor hot; furnished with rooms and seats, delightful, white, and guarded by Varuṇa.

sanskrit: yasyām āste sa varuṇo vāruṇyā saha bhārata divyaratnāmbaradharo bhūṣaṇair upaśobhitaḥ
english: In it sits Varuṇa together with Vāruṇī, O Bhārata, wearing a robe of divine gems, adorned and shining with ornaments.

sanskrit: sragviṇo bhūṣitāś cāpi divyamālyānukarṣiṇaḥ ādityās tatra varuṇaṃ jaleśvaram upāsate
english: Garlanded and adorned, trailing divine garlands, the Ādityas attend there upon Varuṇa the lord of waters.

sanskrit: vāsukis takṣakaś caiva nāgaś cairāvatas tathā kṛṣṇaś ca lohitaś caiva padmaś citraś ca vīryavān
english: Vāsuki and Takṣaka, and the nāga Airāvata as well, Kṛṣṇa and Lohita, and the mighty Padma and Citra.

sanskrit: kambalāśvatarau nāgau dhṛtarāṣṭrabalāhakau maṇimān kuṇḍaladharaḥ karkoṭakadhanaṃjayau
english: The two nāgas Kambala and Aśvatara, Dhṛtarāṣṭra and Balāhaka, Maṇimān, Kuṇḍaladhara, Karkoṭaka and Dhanaṃjaya.

sanskrit: prahlādo mūṣikādaś ca tathaiva janamejayaḥ patākino maṇḍalinaḥ phaṇavantaś ca sarvaśaḥ
english: Prahlāda and Mūṣikāda, and likewise Janamejaya — all of them bearing banners and rings on their hoods, all possessed of hoods.

sanskrit: ete cānye ca bahavaḥ sarpās tasyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira upāsate mahātmānaṃ varuṇaṃ vigataklamāḥ
english: These and many other serpents, O Yudhiṣṭhira, attend in that hall upon the great-souled Varuṇa, free from weariness.

sanskrit: balir vairocano rājā narakaḥ pṛthivīṃjayaḥ prahlādo vipracittiś ca kālakhañjāś ca sarvaśaḥ
english: Bali the son of Virocana, king Naraka, Pṛthivīṃjaya, Prahlāda and Vipracitti, and all the Kālakhañjas.
